A year ago, I made a wish, 
upon the stars so bright.
To spend my time with Mitty, 
so I could see her smile each night.
But life is seldom magic,
it's not a fairy tale.
And sometimes things turn tragic,
and miracles can fail.
But part of life is growing,
and taking that in stride.
The bad and good together,
We face it side by side.
But don't despair, she made it,
she's reading this right now.
And I just want her to know,
she always makes me proud!
We'll always be here with you,
the lucky charms and me!
Because it brings us happineth
To know you're our Mimty~
Mitty and the lucky charms,
what awesome things we've done!
And you know the best part yet?
We've only just begun!
Happy Valentine's Day Mimty! 
From my whole heart, love you, you beautiful blue creatura!
-Gotz
